payload.title: Prepare Open edX annotation packet
payload.description: Evaluate openedx/openedx-platform at pinned commit 555917c7616c57cd644f772c1bb4a999eb15ccbc as a Python education-record corpus candidate. Verify repository identity and license, select a manageable complete scope around the previously identified enrollment, user, and grades models, inventory every included file and exclusion, and prepare scanner-independent proposed annotations for applicable layers. Include positives, realistic negatives, ambiguities, source context, rationale, and provenance. Keep all records proposed pending human review and document the distinct education-domain coverage.
